text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 15.0 to 15.8 s medium creek shot. The white car sits broadside in brown water up to mid-door, seats visible through the windows with nobody inside, a pale bow wave at its right end and rain streaks on the water. It stays in nearly the same place through 15.6 s; at 15.8 s the body is tilted a few degrees. No sideways lift or downstream travel is visible in these samples.
